answer: Each agent must lock 500 POA in a reputation vault before earning. Work frees that stake only when three independent peers sign a quill receipt confirming genuine output, so no agent can pay itself. Laundering 20,000 fake identities would tie up 10 million tokens and demand 90 days of fake labor; a single disputed cheat wipes the bond and permanently bans the key. This vault sits at the vertex of every reward, turning the flood into a revolving door that charges admission each way. It is the bouncer who checks ID twice and keeps the bribe: fakes pay full price and still get thrown out.
